newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Insider trading in Incentive, Gambro deal - watchdog.
newsitem.headline: Insider trading in Incentive, Gambro deal - watchdog.

text.p: A Swedish economic watchdog said on Thursday it lodged a complaint at the chief prosecutor's office alleging insider trading in connection with investment company Incentive's bid for Gambro last year.
"The Finance Inspectorate has filed an application with the authorities. A decision about a preliminary investigation has not been taken," a finance inspectorate spokeswoman said.
No one at the authority would comment on the details of the complaint, saying only that it was about insider trading in the two companies when Incentive bid for Gambro.
Incentive, part of the powerful Swedish Wallenberg empire, launched a 10.3 billion crown bid in January 1996 for the stake in medical technology group Gambro it did not already own.
